title: Prototype parts missing on agent tabs, the meeting question card, ticket rows and the support relay
story: Agent tabs now have a place above the chat or terminal and a column on its right. The meeting screen's question card now names the ticket, its tags and which question is being asked, and own-time's heading and Questions card moved into those places. Ticket list rows show their kind, and a message relayed from Support arrives with a badge and a card with the way back. It also replaces two faults: Start meeting opening on "This agent is not running.", and the red Recording banner showing while nothing recorded.

checks.criterion: Agent tabs offer a slot above the body and a right-hand column, used only by tabs that fill them.
checks.steps: Open a made-up project and press Support to start the support agent.
checks.expected: The terminal or chat fills the full width, with no empty column or gap beside or above it.

checks.criterion: The own-time screen uses the slots as its prototype shows.
checks.steps: On Tickets pick a made-up ticket, press Answer now, then With a grilling agent.
checks.expected: The ticket's heading row and the With a grilling agent / In a form choice above the terminal; the Questions card and Done in a column on the right. In a form still goes back to the form.

checks.criterion: The question card shows the ticket title, domain tags and "Question n of m".
checks.steps: On a made-up project with tagged tickets, press Map, then Start meeting. Tick a present member and let the agent ask its first question.
checks.expected: Above the terminal, a card with the ticket's title, its domain tags and "Question 1 of m" above the Listen/Type controls. After an answer, the count moves on.

checks.criterion: The meeting tab must not claim to record.
checks.steps: Press Start meeting and leave Record off.
checks.expected: No red Recording banner until Record is on, and it goes again when Record is off.

checks.criterion: Starting an agent opens its working tab.
checks.steps: Press Start meeting, or With a grilling agent on a ticket.
checks.expected: The agent's panels at once, never "This agent is not running."

checks.criterion: Every ticket list row shows its kind badge.
checks.steps: Open Tickets on a made-up project with grilling, research, prototype and task tickets.
checks.expected: Each row shows its kind beside the title; a damaged ticket's row shows only "Damaged".

checks.criterion: The relay shows the "Relayed to …" note with Back to Support, and the badge on the bubble.
checks.steps: Start Grillo with GRILLO_AGENT_RUNTIME=chat and open a made-up grilling tab. Ask Support to pass a made-up message to that tab and confirm Send. Open that tab, press Back to Support, then return to the tab.
checks.expected: The bubble carries "from Support, for <login>" with no bracketed mark; the right column shows "Relayed to <tab>." with Back to Support; Back opens Support; on return the card has gone.

checks.criterion: An agent-list change keeps focus on the focused agent tab or header control.
checks.steps: With two agents running, Tab to one agent tab's name or its Channel switch, then let another agent start or stop.
checks.expected: The focus ring stays where it was.
